long_entries.rule: Sweep of sell-side liquidity below equal lows then reversal
Liquidity grab below previous day low with strong close
Stop hunt below session low completes with bullish engulf
Trendline liquidity swept then price closes above

short_entries.rule: Sweep of buy-side liquidity above equal highs then reversal
Liquidity grab above previous day high with strong close
Stop hunt above session high completes with bearish engulf
Trendline liquidity swept then price closes below

synergies.book_62: Liquidity sweeps often coincide with S/D zone touches
synergies.book_56: Sweeps create FVGs and order blocks
